messages:
ana: heads-up onboarding LyraX-8B int4, seeing deterministic loop in long summarization (>2k tokens).

sam: can you paste the exact run command + seed so infra can repro?

ana: `python run_gen.py --model lyrax-8b --quant int4 --max-tokens 2500 --seed 42 --task summarization` — int4 loops around token ~2130 repeating a short phrase, fp16 clean.

carla: any conversion warnings in the logs? rotary/proj-order stuff?

ana: conversion log: WARN rotary_scale changed 1.0->0.9 for some head groups; kvcache shows head_offset +1 for certain shards.

dmitri: smells like headmap/proj-order mismatch or rotary angle-wrap. quick test: try runtime head-swap `--head-order swap:3,7` to see if it reduces loop.

ana: swap reduced looping but ROUGE dropped ~0.7 vs fp16. also ran token-diff: ~23 tokenizer splits differ (ZWJ and composed accents).

ops-bot: queued eval #6112 comparing fp16 / int4 / int4+swap / int4+tokfix — ETA ~8m.

ana: short-term mitigation implemented: runtime fallback flag `--quant-fallback-threshold 1500` to switch to int8 for long requests; opened PRs for conversion mapping fix and tokenizer NFKC normalizer.

ops-bot: eval 6112 complete: ROUGE-L fp16=42.2; int4(raw)=38.5; int4+swap=40.2; int4+tokfix=41.8; int4+fallback=41.9.

carla: fallback gives closest quality. what's latency/cost when fallback triggers?

ana: p50 +8ms, p99 +120ms on ~2k token runs; cost delta +~18% for those requests.

dmitri: plan: land tokenizer normalizer + convert fix, enable fallback feature-flag in staging, run 72h smoke, promote to canary if stable. add sliding-window perplexity job to onboarding harness to detect drift.

sam: add regression test `tests/onboard/lyrax_longctx_repro.txt` and a CI check to verify headmap roundtrip.

ana: done. repro curl for ops: `curl -sS -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d @repro_lyrax_longctx.json`

carla: thx — please update the canary dashboard once fallback flag is toggled.

ana: will do and will ping eng-sre if error-rate >2x baseline.
